summary.body:
Five signals converge on a single asymmetric truth: AI's consumer-subsidy era is being liquidated, and every door it closes opens a bigger one for MindMaker. Anthropic, Google, and Meta are blocking third-party AI subscriptions because autonomous agents burn $200-400/month in compute behind every $20 Claude Pro seat. Microsoft lost $80 per Copilot user. The vendor IPO clock is ticking, and when it lands it transforms AI cost governance from a niche discussion into a board-level mandate. The CFO who gets a surprise $50,000 AI bill is a CFO who calls MindMaker the next morning.

GitHub Spec Kit crossed 100k stars with 206 contributors and 30+ agent integrations under MIT license. The industry just voted: prompt-and-pray is dead, spec-and-ship is the standard. Felix is positioned to own the engineering governance layer that sits on top of this infrastructure. The 'vibe code rescue' audit is not a marketing exercise — it is a massive near-term consulting opportunity validated by Keith Shields at Designli, who quantified the timeline: non-technical founders are roughly two weeks from discovering their AI-generated codebases are coming apart.

Anthropic's Claude for Small Business shipped 15 pre-built workflows across QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, DocuSign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365. The easy consulting wedge ('I'll set up Claude for your QuickBooks') is compressed. This is not a threat. It is a market-clearing event. The bottom-feeders exit. Vertical specialists who handle regulated industries, messy integrations, and compliance complexity inherit a cleaner, less crowded field at higher rates.

The macro thesis sharpens with every signal: AI is undergoing three simultaneous phase transitions — pricing from seats to usage, coding from ad-hoc to auditable, consulting from general to vertical. Each transition creates a governance gap. Governance gaps are where premium advisory revenue materializes. Krish sits at the intersection of all three with the rare advantage of seeing them before the market widely registers the openings. The window in each case is measured in months, not years, and the packages can be built today.

top_3_actions.action: Ship AI cost audit + predictive budgeting service for finance teams. First vendor IPO that forces price correction is the inbound lead generator for every CFO who failed to model actuals.
Launch fixed-price 'vibe code rescue' audit for non-technical founders hitting the 2-week technical debt wall — codebase health snapshot to full governance upsell.

Retire basic AI automation positioning. Refresh all consulting packaging around regulated-industry depth (healthcare, legal, financial services) and complex multi-system integration — Claude SMB commoditized the shallow end.

summary.blockers: No blockers. The market is moving faster than incumbents can adapt, and every signal strengthens MindMaker's positioning at the inflection point. Clear runway.
